verdict.rationale: Orb's first-party docs describe a real-time webhooks system that sends HTTP calls to a user-chosen endpoint when certain events occur. This is a documented, registrable outbound callback mechanism a programmatic consumer can receive. However, the evidence is a single high-level statement. Missing for 10: documented event-type catalog, delivery details (signature verification, retries, ordering), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Orb provides a powerful, real-time webhooks system that can issue calls to an endpoint of your choosing when certain events take place.
